```{python}
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".")
from _helpers import fig, table
```

Domains are [Pfam](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/entry/pfam/) hits with `domain_i_evalue <= 1e-5`, version suffix removed, as in `bin/atlas/sql/J2_pfam.sql`. Counts are per genome (one representative per species). The top families by prevalence (plus a curated panel) are kept.

## Domains per protein

```{python}
fig("F06_domains_per_protein", "Share of proteins with 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5+ Pfam domains, mean over genomes in each phylum.")
```

The "0" class combines proteins with no Pfam hit and proteins whose hits fail the gate; it also depends on how much of the proteome carries a scan result (see the coverage caveat in [Data and methods](06_data_notes.qmd)).

## Most widespread domains

```{python}
fig("F07_pfam_prevalence", "Fraction of genomes in each phylum that carry each of the 30 most widespread domains.", "80%")

```

```{python}
fig("F08_pfam_phylum_variance", "Mean copies per 10,000 genes (log scale), z-scored across phyla, for the 40 domains with the largest between-phylum variance (domains present in at least 30% of genomes of some phylum and averaging at least 0.5 copies per 10,000 genes).", "80%")
fig("F09_pfam_breadth", "Number of the retained Pfam families present per genome.")
```
